prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Baytown, Texas, and has wrist fracture. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1445; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle that was rear-ended.
Q: That's fine. Can you tell me where the collision happened?
A: It was on a main road in Baytown, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped at a red light when it happened.
Q: Describe what you remember about the impact.
A: I was sitting at the light, waiting for it to change. Next thing I knew, there was a loud bang and my car lurched forward. I grabbed the steering wheel with both hands and my right wrist took most of the force.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was. The airbag didn't deploy, but the belt locked up hard across my chest.
Q: Did you get out of the vehicle at the scene?
A: I did, though I was shaky. The other driver came over and said he hadn't seen the light change in time. A police officer arrived and took a report.
Q: What injuries have you experienced since the accident?
A: My right wrist was swollen and really painful right away. I went to the emergency room that evening, and they took X-rays. The doctor told me it's a fracture, and I have a cast on it now.
Q: Have you missed any work because of the injury?
A: Yes, I'm a delivery driver, so I can't work with a cast like this. I've been off work since the accident, and I'm still waiting on a follow-up appointment with an orthopedic specialist.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I'm following my doctor's instructions and I'm willing to provide my medical records. I just want this handled fairly.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
